# sibling skills repository rather than in .github/skills/.

# devtools/verify_agent_skill_refs.py uses this list so a legitimate
# cross-repo reference is not reported as a BROKEN REF in the neqsim-only CI
# checkout, where the sibling repos are not available for dynamic resolution.
#
# Format: one skill name per line, optionally followed by the owning repo.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
